smyx-reptile-thermoregulation-behavior-analysis 1.0.2

- Internal Python files updated: scripts/dao.py and scripts/util.py.
- Documentation cleanup: removed skill-card.md file. 
- No user-facing changes in functionality or workflow.

- Major update: Identity handling and data security improved, with refined workflows and user experience.
- Internal user identity (open-id) is now processed automatically; users are never prompted to input or see identity values.
- Cloud-only querying for historical reports enforced; all manual/local history lookups are strictly forbidden.
- Documentation, resource index, and workflow instructions reorganized for greater clarity and compliance with privacy standards.
- Outdated files removed; detailed parameter tables and scenario codes added for developer reference.
- Skill description and usage expanded to better guide both end-users and developers.

smyx-reptile-thermoregulation-behavior-analysis v1.0.0

- Initial release of automated reptile behavior analysis for thermoregulation.
- Supports video-based monitoring of lizards, snakes, and turtles using fixed enclosure cameras.
- Detects and reports movement frequency and dwell duration between basking and hiding zones.
- Outputs daily thermal zone utilization reports, including preference classification and activity rhythms.
- Provides alert escalation based on behavioral anomalies, with species-specific logic and context-awareness.
- Strict open-id control and cloud-based historical report retrieval included.
